Each crop performs RGB and TIR primary encoder/head calls, giving 24 calls and 24 actual returned candidates. Both feature maps are pooled at each candidate, producing 24x2x768 features with explicit 24x2 coverage. Two additional encoder calls per sequence create the fixed first-frame anchor. Counts exclude ordinary paired E0 prediction calls; no claim of zero extra forwards applies to this M2 collector.

Primary normalized cxcywh is mapped through that query's left/top/side and clipped with original E0 margin10 rules. Both returned image boxes are transformed back to that same crop's normalized cxcywh before pooling each modality. ROI pooling samples a spatial 3x3 grid over the primary 16x16 features with align_corners=False and explicit coverage. The crop helper's normalized ltwh return is ignored; anchor coordinates are computed explicitly as cxcywh.
